constraints.description: The ordinary Dart entry and optional DevTools entry must each have a source-derived, fail-closed public declaration ledger wired into the root verifier and API generator.

validation.validation_method: Run pnpm run verify:dart-exports and pnpm run verify:skills; require 93 root and 100 DevTools declarations.

constraints.description: Public guidance must preserve the optional entry, one controller per graph, reference-counted lifecycle, graph publication ownership, Riverpod logical views, explicit store IDs, and isolate-wide VM-service router.

validation.validation_method: Compare package, release, website, and skill guidance with devtools.dart, controller.dart, graph.dart, providers.dart, and vm_service.dart.

constraints.description: Security guidance must name the VM service as a debugger trust boundary, metadata-only defaults, host-owned redaction, non-escalating commands, payload/history limits, secret URI handling, debug-mode activation, and deterministic detach.

validation.validation_method: Inspect the Docusaurus security page, package README, skill reference, VM-service source, and accepted redaction/bounds receipt.

constraints.description: The final controller receipt must remain pass, name the platform-neutral Flutter/Riverpod/VM-service boundary, retain 28 versioned events, point to the tested source commit, and contain no actual sentinel value, token names, host path, or raw debugger URI.

validation.validation_method: Parse task-8-assembled-acceptance.json, verify exact status/boundary/event count/source commit, and scan forbidden sensitive markers.

constraints.description: No artifact may claim that pub.dev 3.0.1 contains devtools.dart or that the separate Flutter DevTools extension UI, documentation deployment, immutable release SHA, or next package publication is complete.

validation.validation_method: Require the repository-source, published-archive, pending-extension, and later-release distinctions in every public guide.

constraints.description: QA must rely on the completed assembled gate plus deterministic ledger/content checks and must not create or run unit, widget, component, isolated, mock-backed, snapshot, golden, or partial integration tests.

validation.validation_method: Inspect task evidence, session commands, and QA report for gate classification and excluded test types.

global_rules: Preserve the graph as the sole owner of business state.
Do not authorize registry publication or claim the pending extension UI is complete.
Do not expose raw diagnostics, VM-service URIs, debugger tokens, registry credentials, sentinel values, or host-local paths.
Do not create or run unit, widget, component, isolated, mock-backed, snapshot, golden, or partial integration tests.
termination_conditions: All six blocking constraints are satisfied.
Both Dart ledgers and the complete skills ledger gate pass.
The accepted assembled receipt remains intact and sanitized.
No further content change improves API traceability, security clarity, or scope honesty.
